exposure: subsequent pregnancies (SSPs) in women with peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM)
cohort: The study included 45 women with peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) who had subsequent pregnancies, with a mean age of 27.0 years, 80% of whom were of African American descent.
finding: Subsequent pregnancies in women with peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) are associated with adverse events, and normalization of left ventricular function does not guarantee a favorable outcome.
